info.title: API.SH: Idealo
info.description: The Idealo API from API.SH: public Idealo data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A category listing on idealo.de: products with price, number of offers, shop, rating, key specs and image, plus the category's result total and price range. 36 products a page; sort by popularity, price, biggest saving or newest. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/idealo-category

get.description:
A shop's user reviews on idealo.de, newest first, 15 per page: author, title, text, date, overall stars, the order process, delivery and packaging and service stars, and the shop's answer. Review snippets for a product are in `/idealo/v1/product`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/idealo-reviews

get.description:
Products and offers on idealo.de for a search: name, price, offer count, shop, test rating, rating count, characteristics, badges and link. Also the category the search landed in (`category_id`), its refinements with hit counts (`facets`: brand, series, storage, colour and every other filter group the site shows), price bands, item-state counts, the selected filters and related searches. To narrow a search, pass `category_id` and filter ids from `facets[].filters[].id` back as `filters`; `sort` orders by popularity or price. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/idealo-search

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` from the previous response; `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: The `category_id` of a previous answer for this search; needed with `filters`.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filter ids from `facets[].filters[].id`, comma separated (up to 10), e.g. `1827298` for brand Apple. Needs `category_id`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
What idealo.de's search box suggests for a partial query: suggested searches with the category they belong to, the category id and link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/idealo-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What has been typed so far.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
